_comment: MLA vs GQA vs MHA. The unit of data is a SEQUENCE, so the micro batch below counts sequences. train_batch_size is deliberately OMITTED so DeepSpeed derives it and any --num_gpus works without editing this file.
_precision_comment: Both disabled ON PURPOSE. The quantity being compared across variants is a loss difference of order 0.1 nats between three attention implementations; running one of them in reduced precision would be measuring the dtype. MLA's low-rank reconstruction also multiplies two learned matrices before the softmax, which is exactly where fp16's narrow range bites. These models are ~1.6M parameters -- fp32 costs nothing here.
_zero_comment: Stage 0, and the reason is the point of the example. ZeRO shards optimizer state, gradients and parameters -- none of which is the KV cache. The cache is an INFERENCE cost that ZeRO never touches, which is precisely why MLA exists as a separate idea. Sharding a 1.6M-parameter model would add communication to save kilobytes and teach the wrong lesson.
